title: North Yorkshire off road driving business accelerates growth with HSBC UK support - About HSBC | HSBC UK
description: Off road driving experience specialist is gearing up growth plans with the acquisition of new premises supported by HSBC UK.

headings.text: North Yorkshire off road driving business accelerates growth with HSBC UK support

Dalesway Yorkshire has utilised a £850,000 funding package from HSBC UK to acquire property on the grounds of North Yorkshire’s 1,400 acre estate Coniston Hotel Country Estate.

The HSBC UK backed investment includes the purchase and development of a new 300 sq. metre steel-frame workshop adjacent to a former barn, providing a modern, purpose-built space to support Dalesway Yorkshire’s expanding training operations.
As part of the full refit, the business will complete the installation of new windows, underfloor heating, an open-plan layout and establishment of mezzanine office space.

This growth strategy will safeguard 35 existing jobs, with the opportunity to expand the team further as demand increases. With the added capacity and long-term security that comes from owning its new premises, Dalesway Yorkshire is forecasting a 10 per cent year-on-year increase in turnover.
The business, which operates a fleet of 24 vehicles, is expected to relocate to the newly developed facility by 1st September 2026.

Jonathan Rumboll, Director at Dalesway Yorkshire, said: “Securing this new facility marks a major milestone for our business. Having ownership to reinvest and upgrade the premises will give us the space, control and long-term stability we need to continue developing our driving experience offering. The funding from HSBC UK has allowed us to transform a disused barn in a highly sought after location, enabling us to provide a high-quality, modern centre that reflects the professionalism of our team and the expectations of our clients.”

Ben Carver, Relationship Manager at HSBC UK, added: “We’re proud to support Dalesway Yorkshire as it expands its operations in North Yorkshire. The new facility will provide the business with a purpose-built training centre, supporting local jobs and creating a platform for future expansion. This is a strong example of a specialist operator with growth ambitions, and we’re pleased our funding is helping to drive forward long-term plans.”

Dalesway Yorkshire, based in Skipton, operates a Land Rover Experience and driver training centre that specialises in 4x4, ATV and trailer training for guests, as well as professional training for individuals seeking recognised off-road driving qualifications. The fleet also includes a collection of heritage and contemporary vehicles.
Dalesway Yorkshire has secured £850,000 funding package from HSBC UK L-R: Nick Rumboll, Dalesway Yorkshire; Ben Carver, HSBC UK; Richard Rumboll, Dalesway Yorkshire.

HSBC UK is a ring-fenced bank and wholly-owned subsidiary of HSBC Holdings plc.

HSBC Holdings plc HSBC Holdings plc, the parent company of HSBC, is headquartered in London. HSBC serves customers worldwide from offices in 56 countries and territories. With assets of US$3,233bn at 31 December 2025, HSBC is one of the world’s largest banking and financial services organisations.
